entities.facing_rule: not directional; highlight and stripe angle remain consistent while swap motion rotates slightly
entities.animation_rule: CandyBoardView draws glossy rounded candy bodies with pulse, wobble, and pop timing during swaps and clears
entities.movement_rule: cell-centered grid movement with tweened swap and gravity-driven cascade drop

entities.facing_rule: striped orientation follows stored special type and rainbow uses radial sweep only
entities.animation_rule: Striped candies flash and launch line clears, wrapped candies pulse with a larger body, and rainbow candies emit a board-scan glow
entities.movement_rule: inherits normal candy swap and cascade motion until activation

entities.animation_rule: Frosting uses layered crack states and jelly uses translucent under-glow that fades when cleared
entities.movement_rule: static board occupants that only transition through damage and removal states

entities.facing_rule: particles radiate from clear origin or along line-clear direction
entities.animation_rule: Pop bursts, syrup waves, and shard sprays stack over the board with short-lived additive celebration timing
entities.movement_rule: free particle motion decays over time and never blocks input
